beats.label: S1 · The accidental pregnancy
beats.text: Chaste 23-year-old Jane is accidentally inseminated with hotelier Rafael's sample by his doctor sister Luisa; the pregnancy upends her engagement to cop Michael.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the entire love triangle and premise the whole show runs on.

beats.label: S1 · Rogelio, the missing father
beats.text: Xo confesses that Jane's father is Rogelio, a vain telenovela star she once slept with; Jane cautiously lets him into her life.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Rogelio becomes a series regular and Xo's on-off partner from here on.

beats.label: S1 · Petra's dangerous game
beats.text: Rafael's scheming wife Petra fights to hold the marriage together for the payout; her mother Magda pushes Alba down the stairs to protect their cover.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Petra and Magda as ongoing threats woven into the criminal plots.

beats.label: S1 · Sin Rostro at the hotel
beats.text: Michael investigates a mysterious crime lord, Sin Rostro, running an underground plastic-surgery lab hidden beneath Rafael's Marbella hotel.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Sin Rostro thread drives the criminal spine of the entire series.

beats.label: S1 · Rose unmasked
beats.text: Sin Rostro is revealed to be Rose, Rafael's stepmother and Luisa's secret lover; she has murdered Rafael's father Emilio and is now on the loose.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Rose is the season's engine and stays the central villain going forward.

beats.label: S1 · Jane picks Michael
beats.text: Jane and Rafael's romance collapses; she remains ambivalent about Michael and gives birth to a son named Mateo.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Jane and Michael's alignment and delivers the baby the whole show revolves around.

beats.label: S1 · Mateo taken
beats.text: Moments after Mateo's birth, a hospital nurse snatches him from the nursery and hands him to Rose, who drives off with the newborn.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the direct cliffhanger — S2 opens on the frantic search for Mateo.

cliffhanger.text: Newborn Mateo has just been kidnapped from the hospital nursery. A nurse handed him to Rose — the crime lord Sin Rostro — who has driven off with the baby.
questions: Where has Rose taken baby Mateo?
Can Michael catch up to Sin Rostro before it's too late?
With Jane engaged to Michael, is Rafael truly out of the picture?

characters.name: Jane Villanueva
characters.line: Chaste 23-year-old aspiring writer accidentally inseminated with Rafael's sample; just gave birth to Mateo and is engaged to Michael.

characters.name: Rafael Solano
characters.line: Marbella hotel owner, cancer survivor and Mateo's biological father; recently separated from Petra.

characters.name: Michael Cordero
characters.line: Jane's detective fiancé, the officer who finally uncovered Rose as Sin Rostro.

characters.name: Petra Solano
characters.line: Rafael's scheming ex-wife (real name Natalia), tangled with her mother Magda and shifting alliances at the hotel.

characters.name: Rose Solano
characters.line: Rafael's stepmother, revealed as crime lord Sin Rostro; she killed Rafael's father and has just kidnapped Mateo.

characters.name: Luisa Alver
characters.line: Rafael's unstable ob-gyn sister who accidentally inseminated Jane; obsessed with Rose.

characters.name: Xiomara Villanueva
characters.line: Jane's mother, a struggling singer who had Jane at 16; back in something with Rogelio.

characters.name: Rogelio de la Vega
characters.line: Vain telenovela superstar and Jane's newly-discovered father, working his way into the family.

characters.name: Alba Villanueva
characters.line: Jane's devout, undocumented grandmother; recovering after Magda pushed her down the stairs.

beats.label: S2 · Chip for the baby
beats.text: Michael trades a stolen data chip to Rose for Mateo's safe return; Jane and Rafael settle into raising the newborn together.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the S1 cliffhanger and re-centers the family around the baby.

beats.label: S2 · Petra's stolen sperm
beats.text: Petra secretly inseminates herself with Rafael's stored second sperm sample and is soon carrying his twins.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Twins Anna and Elsa become permanent additions and lock Petra into Rafael's life.

beats.label: S2 · Jane finally picks Michael
beats.text: After circling both men, Jane chooses Michael for good; they reunite and eventually get engaged.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the S1 triangle and sets the wedding as the season's target.

beats.label: S2 · Michael undercover
beats.text: Michael goes deep undercover for months, faking his own police-force disgrace to hunt Sin Rostro's rival crime lord, Mutter.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The undercover work is what eventually collides with Rafael's family.

beats.label: S2 · Mutter is Rafael's mother
beats.text: Rafael discovers that the crime lord Mutter is his long-lost birth mother; devastated, he cooperates with police to help bring her in.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Rafael's parentage becomes the identity crisis that unravels his S3 fortune.

beats.label: S2 · The wedding, the twins
beats.text: Michael arrests Mutter and marries Jane in a joyful ceremony; Petra gives birth to Rafael's twin girls, Anna and Elsa.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Both family units — the newlyweds and the twins — are the shape S3 inherits.

beats.label: S2 · The double gut-punch
beats.text: That same night, Petra's twin Anezka drugs and takes her place, and an unseen shooter guns Michael down.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The double cliffhanger is precisely what S3 opens on.

cliffhanger.text: Michael has just been shot moments after his and Jane's wedding, and Petra's identical twin Anezka has drugged her to take her place — nobody yet knows either has happened.
questions: How long can Anezka pass herself off as Petra?
With Mutter captured, where has Rose slipped away to?

characters.name: Jane Villanueva
characters.line: Newlywed to Michael and mother to baby Mateo; the shooting cuts her wedding night short.

characters.name: Michael Cordero
characters.line: Jane's husband, fresh off arresting Mutter — now bleeding out from an unseen shooter's bullet.

characters.name: Rafael Solano
characters.line: Co-parenting Mateo; recently discovered the crime lord Mutter is his birth mother, and still carries a torch for Jane.

characters.name: Petra Solano
characters.line: Just gave birth to Rafael's twin girls Anna and Elsa; drugged and swapped by her twin at the wedding.

characters.name: Anezka
characters.line: Petra's identical twin sister, now impersonating her to seize the hotel and Rafael.

characters.name: Rose
characters.line: Still Sin Rostro, spent much of the season hidden in a stolen identity; slipped the net after Mutter's arrest.

characters.name: Luisa Alver
characters.line: Rafael's sister, still emotionally entangled with Rose and drifting on the fringes of the family.

characters.name: Rogelio de la Vega
characters.line: Jane's telenovela-star father, navigating his on-again off-again relationship with Xo.

characters.name: Xiomara Villanueva
characters.line: Jane's mother, broken up with Rogelio over the baby issue but still acting like a couple.

characters.name: Alba Villanueva
characters.line: Jane's grandmother, still the family's moral anchor.

beats.label: S3 · Michael survives
beats.text: Michael pulls through the shooting; he quits the police force to become a lawyer, and he and Jane finally consummate their marriage.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Restores the wedding-night status quo and sets Michael's new career path.

beats.label: S3 · Anezka in Petra's skin
beats.text: Petra's twin Anezka impersonates her for months; along the way she marries Rafael's assistant Scott.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Anezka's grip on Petra's life is the season's engine and rolls into S4.

beats.label: S3 · Rafael loses everything
beats.text: Rafael learns he is not biologically a Solano and forfeits the family fortune; his cover-up of his father's crimes lands him in prison.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Rafael's fall from wealth resets his position for the rest of the show.

beats.label: S3 · Michael's death, three years later
beats.text: Tragedy strikes and Michael suddenly dies; the story leaps three years ahead, past Jane's grief and Rafael's prison stint.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The seismic event of the series and the time jump that defines S4's texture.

beats.label: S3 · The new normal
beats.text: Post-jump, Rafael is out of jail and rebuilding the Marbella with Petra; Jane, now a published author and widowed mom, becomes his closest friend.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the settled dynamic the audience walks into for S4.

beats.label: S3 · Rose caged, Luisa scorned
beats.text: Rose is captured and jailed; after Rafael helps lure Luisa in, a scorned Luisa vows revenge on him while Anezka plots her own strike on Petra.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Luisa's revenge and Rose's imprisonment drive the entire S4 conspiracy.

beats.label: S3 · A gun at the wedding
beats.text: At Rogelio and Xo's wedding, Anezka slips away from the reception and corners Petra alone in a room, holding her at gunpoint.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Direct cliffhanger — S4 opens on Petra escaping this moment.

cliffhanger.text: Rogelio and Xo have finally married. Rose is jailed at last, but Luisa is scheming revenge on Rafael — and Anezka has cornered Petra alone with a gun.
questions: What revenge is Luisa about to unleash on Rafael?
Can Rose really stay behind bars?

characters.name: Jane Villanueva
characters.line: Widowed after Michael's death, now a published author and single mom to four-year-old Mateo; closest confidante of Rafael.

characters.name: Rafael Solano
characters.line: Freshly out of prison, rebuilding the Marbella with Petra and co-parenting Mateo; no longer a biological Solano.

characters.name: Petra Solano
characters.line: Running the rebranded Marbella and mother to twins Anna and Ellie; just held at gunpoint by her twin.

characters.name: Anezka
characters.line: Petra's twin, no longer impersonating her and now openly out for blood.

characters.name: Mateo Villanueva
characters.line: Jane's four-year-old son, acting out at school in the wake of losing Michael.

characters.name: Rose
characters.line: The crime lord Sin Rostro, finally captured and imprisoned after years on the run.

characters.name: Luisa Alver
characters.line: Rafael's sister, plotting revenge after Rafael lied about his cancer to lure her back to Miami.

characters.name: Rogelio de la Vega
characters.line: Telenovela star just married to Xo; also expecting a baby with reality-star Darci.

characters.name: Xiomara Villanueva
characters.line: Just married Rogelio; runs a dance studio and is dating him for real at last.

characters.name: Alba Villanueva
characters.line: Jane's grandmother, tentatively dating Jorge, her co-worker.

beats.label: S4 · Anezka, gone for good
beats.text: Petra shoves Anezka into the sea to escape her gun; Anezka survives, resurfaces, and eventually dies in a fall from the balcony after Petra outmaneuvers her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the twin threat but leaves Petra legally exposed for Anezka's death.

beats.label: S4 · Adam and a housemate
beats.text: Rafael loses the Marbella to Luisa via Anezka's scheme and moves in with the Villanuevas; Jane briefly rekindles with her first love, Adam.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Jane and Rafael under one roof and dispatches Adam as a temporary detour.

beats.label: S4 · Jane and Rafael, again
beats.text: Adam takes a job in California and breaks up with Jane; she and Rafael share a first kiss and cautiously begin dating again.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Jane/Rafael reunion is the emotional spine of what follows.

beats.label: S4 · Petra and J.R.
beats.text: Petra is arrested for Anezka's murder on planted evidence; her sharp lawyer Jane Ramos ('J.R.') defends her and the two fall into a romance.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces J.R. as Petra's partner — a defining relationship of the last stretch.

beats.label: S4 · The parents mystery
beats.text: Rafael digs for his real biological parents, but Luisa vanishes and Rose starts blackmailing him to reveal Luisa's location.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Rose's leverage over Rafael is what sets up the finale twist.

beats.label: S4 · Xo's cancer
beats.text: Xo is diagnosed with breast cancer and endures chemotherapy that takes a heavy toll on her health.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Xo's illness is the family's ongoing crisis carrying into S5.

beats.label: S4 · The proposal that isn't
beats.text: Rafael prepares to propose to Jane, but a call from Rose in prison shakes him — and in a shocking twist, he reveals the reason to Jane.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The exact hook S5 opens on: what Rose said to Rafael.

cliffhanger.text: Rafael was on the verge of proposing to Jane when a call from Rose in prison stopped him. In a shocking twist, he reveals the reason to Jane.
questions: Can Rafael and Jane's rekindled relationship survive whatever he's hiding?
What is Rose plotting from behind bars?

characters.name: Jane Villanueva
characters.line: Rekindled with Rafael and expecting a proposal she doesn't yet realise won't come.

characters.name: Rafael Solano
characters.line: Living with Jane after losing the Marbella; about to propose, until Rose's call froze him.

characters.name: Petra Solano
characters.line: Cleared of Anezka's death and in a serious relationship with her former lawyer J.R.

characters.name: Jane Ramos ('J.R.')
characters.line: Petra's high-powered attorney who took her case, then her heart.

characters.name: Mateo Villanueva
characters.line: Jane and Rafael's school-age son, the reason they keep circling each other.

characters.name: Rose
characters.line: Still imprisoned but holding the secret about Rafael's parentage — and something bigger — over him.

characters.name: Luisa Alver
characters.line: Rafael's sister, cut out of his life after the hotel scheme and now nowhere to be found.

characters.name: Rogelio de la Vega
characters.line: TV star juggling Xo's illness, his baby with Darci, and his American crossover.

characters.name: Xiomara Villanueva
characters.line: Just finished a brutal round of chemotherapy; recovering but changed by it.

characters.name: Alba Villanueva
characters.line: Newly naturalised US citizen; her romance with Jorge finally on solid ground.

beats.label: S5 · Michael is alive
beats.text: Rose reveals to Rafael that Michael is alive: kidnapped, given amnesia, and living as 'Jason' with no memory of Jane or their life together.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The premise-shattering reveal that reopens the S1/S2 triangle years later.

beats.label: S5 · Memories, and a Montana trip
beats.text: Jane retraces old memories with Jason and eventually triggers his full recall; she chooses Michael, but a trip to Montana clarifies she truly loves Rafael.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Delivers the final, definitive choice between the two men.

beats.label: S5 · Winning Rafael back
beats.text: Rafael tells Jane it is too late; she pursues him relentlessly until they rebuild, and he eventually proposes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The endgame commitment that the finale is built around.

beats.label: S5 · Xo cancer-free, New York calls
beats.text: Xo is declared cancer-free after her long treatment; Rogelio's American telenovela pushes them to plan a move to New York.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Xo and Rogelio's post-show life and the family's coming split.

beats.label: S5 · Petra's fight, J.R.'s exit
beats.text: J.R. takes a Houston job and breaks up with Petra; Petra outmaneuvers Milos with a Krishna double-cross and reclaims full control of the Marbella.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets Petra as sole hotel owner heading into the finale.

beats.label: S5 · Rose ends
beats.text: Rose escapes prison and takes Jane hostage in her own home; Luisa pushes Rose down the stairs to her death, ending the Sin Rostro saga for good.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the criminal spine that has run the entire series.

beats.label: S5 · The wedding and the reveal
beats.text: Jane and Rafael marry; J.R. returns for Petra, the narrator is revealed as a grown Mateo, and Jane's novel becomes the telenovela we've been watching.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The finale itself — meta reveal that recontextualises the entire series.

cliffhanger.text: The story ends here. Jane and Rafael are married, Rose is dead, Petra and J.R. are back together, and the narrator has revealed himself as a grown Mateo, telling the story that becomes the telenovela.
questions: How will the family adjust once Rogelio and Xo move to New York?
What life is Mateo growing into as he tells this story?
What next chapter awaits Petra, J.R., and the twins?

characters.name: Jane Villanueva
characters.line: Newly married to Rafael; a published author whose novel is being adapted into a telenovela.

characters.name: Rafael Solano
characters.line: Jane's husband at last, working real estate after leaving the Marbella behind.

characters.name: Michael Cordero
characters.line: Returned as 'Jason' with amnesia, recovered his memory, then let Jane go; engaged to Charlie and expecting a child.

characters.name: Petra Solano
characters.line: Sole owner of the Marbella again, reunited with J.R. at the wedding.

characters.name: Jane Ramos ('J.R.')
characters.line: Petra's on-again partner, back in Miami to be with her.

characters.name: Rose
characters.line: Escaped prison, then killed by Luisa on the stairs of Jane's home.

characters.name: Luisa Alver
characters.line: Rafael's sister, who worked with police against Rose and delivered the fatal push.

characters.name: Rogelio de la Vega
characters.line: Bound for New York with Xo to keep the American telenovela and to stay near his daughter Baby.

characters.name: Xiomara Villanueva
characters.line: Cancer-free and moving to New York with Rogelio.

characters.name: Alba Villanueva
characters.line: US citizen, remarried to Jorge, still the family's anchor.

characters.name: Mateo Villanueva
characters.line: Jane and Rafael's six-year-old son — and, it turns out, the grown-up narrator of the whole story.
